entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. Available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or managed cloud, it utilizes temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval to maintain persistent context.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It employs a three-tier loading system (L0/L1/L2) to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains through background memory extraction and vector search.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from text, code, and session data. It supports session distillation and retrieval across various LLM providers, ensuring memory remains consistent over time.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: gbrain functions as an opinionated agent brain that stores facts with provenance, allowing for specific memory withdrawals and corrections. It constructs a knowledge graph with typed edges to generate synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine features a custom vector graph graph and byte-level deduplication to support sub-300ms recall at high scale. It automates fact extraction and knowledge updates while offering native connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements a learning-based memory workflow focused on retain, recall, and reflect operations. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends, offering SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go to facilitate long-term agent learning.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library serves as the foundation for stateful agents by extracting reasoning-based conclusions from conversation histories. It is implemented as a FastAPI server and supports flexible deployment through managed hosting, local CLI, or Docker-based self-hosting.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Byterover-cli treats memory as a git repository, providing version control features like branching and merging for markdown-based context trees. This official provider uses a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance across 20 LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Designed for Hermes Agents, this zero-dependency system uses a single SQLite database to provide sub-millisecond memory operations. It features temporal recall and episodic compression, with MCP support for integration into tools like Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This system utilizes a seven-layer memory architecture, including vector search on Qdrant and an auto-curated wiki, to manage agent context. It establishes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure the agent prioritizes specific injected context over other data.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive harness that improves agent performance on complex tasks by retaining lessons and artifacts through iterative execution. It stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated data within the filesystem to support self-improving workflows.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no message is ever lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep to recover specific details from the persistent message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from over 20 different coding agents to enable natural-language search across months of past data. It provides millisecond lookups over gigabytes of data while redacting keys and tokens for safety.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference server for flexible deployment.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process to provide portable state across multiple agent clients. It achieves 97.6% average LongMemEval accuracy and supports real-time ingestion from GitHub, Discord, and Obsidian.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur uses an open engram YAML format to store shared memory as plain-text files for local ownership. It utilizes hybrid BM25 and embedding search to provide local-first retrieval for MCP-compatible tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and plugins, employing a hybrid retrieval system that combines BM25 and vector search.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses a SQLite-backed five-tier hierarchical schema instead of vector databases or embeddings. It offers a five-package plugin family including a dedicated Hermes adapter and FTS5 search capabilities.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin offers explainable recall by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result and tracking memory contradictions through first-class primitives. It supports an embedded in-process backend suitable for serverless deployments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It runs local embedding models for hybrid BM25 and semantic search without requiring telemetry or external databases.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: Designed as a machine interface for agents, this CLI maintains persistent knowledge using a SQLite backend. It allows agents to autonomously recall and evolve source-grounded knowledge while supporting portable memory archives for data merging.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It functions as an MCP-native server that utilizes GGUF models for vector search.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with specific evidence packets for each query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to reduce prompt token usage by up to 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and utilizes edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed for Hermes Agent v0.14.0, this tool reduces schema overhead through local BM25 keyword selection and tool ranking. It includes a dedicated dashboard for monitoring estimated token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It offers a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents across different platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with importance-weighted recall to ensure high-priority entries surface during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all prefetch operations. It distinguishes itself by supporting immediate, real event deletion to prevent old summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail is an SDK and MCP server that enables agents to settle payments directly to wallets across 37 chains, including EVM and Solana. It allows APIs to charge for services and agents to pay for them using USDC and other stablecoins with local RPC verification.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes and routes queries to local skills, scripts, and MCP servers. It includes specialized tools for neighbor traversal and knowledge search, featuring automatic generation of routing notes via model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. The system ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox for searching and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports manual memory storage and utilizes configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve retrieval accuracy.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault provides private local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic search and grounded Q&A through deterministic slash commands. It requires a local server for indexing and offers LLM-callable tools for models with structured tool use.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication for stored data.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It enhances agent efficiency through automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve relevant information.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This lightweight, file-based toolkit focuses on memory hygiene by using a git-backed directory for versioned and diffable markdown storage without a database. It features five slash commands for capture and recall, alongside 'rot' and 'lint' curators that identify stale data or contradictions to propose evidence-cited updates.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to execute tasks autonomously while enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles. It functions as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs to streamline software development methodologies.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes and 25 other CLI executables to generate web, mobile, and desktop prototypes with sandboxed previews. It supports project exports in multiple formats, including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance security-specific capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool generates editable .drawio files from prompts, images, or Mermaid text to visualize infrastructure like AWS and Kubernetes. It also enforces architecture contracts and renders visual diffs within CI pipelines.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer alongside vendored protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It is compatible with Hermes-adjacent tools like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and agentskills.io.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library compatible with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and monitoring session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 14 metaskills that maintain state within a project's documentation folder. These skills are packaged as spec-conformant plugins for Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life-task skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills are designed to run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent and other platforms to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and offers a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds while providing slash commands for pattern management.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes tools for reading bundled resources and executing untrusted scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate them from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It features Lite and Full modes for varying project complexities and includes a review gate that evaluates specifications using PASS/FAIL models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill generates .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable files from documentation and automatically syncs source edits back to the original literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that utilizes SQLite and Git for local-first session storage. It implements the SLP protocol for supervised teams and uses Markdown-based recipes to facilitate prompt-first working methods.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven project provides Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configurations specifically in Portuguese. All resources follow the agentskills.io standard and are documented in the SKILL.md format.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable agent discovery and interaction with Chainlink services like CCIP, Data Feeds, and VRF. They are installable via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI for smart contract integration.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project offers official skills for FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models, including a router to direct requests to specialized agents. It supports full BFL API integration with features for polling, webhooks, and error handling.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates agentskills.io-compliant skills from code, documentation, and developer discourse. It manages the skill lifecycle by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits for version-controlled exports.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock is a registry for reusable AI skills that includes a Python client and a CLI for installation. It supports recursive dependency resolution and features a commerce system powered by TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows using a .nika.yaml file format and a single Rust binary for local-first execution. It includes a check command to audit task dependencies and estimate costs across various models.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of decisions. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This project serves as a community hub for browsing and installing skills, fully implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The architecture reduces token consumption and features graceful degradation if specific embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly personal execution system, this project manages habits and study blocks through agent-driven scheduling via MCP. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only tool performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple interfaces like Discord and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports five programming languages and employs a risk-tiered application process that requires an approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates to ground agent actions. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern that supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and automatically registers common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite adds session management and worktree recovery tools to provide memory between agent conversations and detect state drift. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for developing new skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure secure local session monitoring.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories using vhs or Playwright scripts. It handles rendering, optimizes files to target sizes under 8 MB, and embeds the resulting markdown directly into the README.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills for integration with clients like Hermes and Cursor. It provides direct installation commands for discovered plugins to streamline agent capability expansion.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs to detect and report drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compatible with specific runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures Hermes Agent can correctly route file operations and verify project-compatible interpreters without new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the OpenClaw ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This tool certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill actually works.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with human approval gating the final 85% payout.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools and five production-grade skills via a hosted MCP server for structured web data access. It supports multiple platforms including Hermes, Claude, and Cursor to facilitate data-driven workflows.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It integrates user interests via semantic memory and applies quality gates to produce structured conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized Chinese-language tools for video-to-text transcription, document OCR, and e-commerce material processing. It includes a rule-based engine designed to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns from generated text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents and terminal tools, including Hermes, with daily automated updates. It enables immediate execution through direct GitHub flake references, ensuring users have access to the latest versions of the agent and its desktop applications.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface components.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. The deployment includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile agent management.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring a configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It extends agent functionality with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging, alongside support for scheduled tasks via cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for the agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-level enforcement. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora serves as a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. The platform prioritizes security through AES-256-GCM encryption for secrets and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific versions of the agent using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed for autonomous execution, specifically supporting recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, offering isolated data environments for Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that pre-indexes symbols and callers to minimize token usage for Hermes Agent. It automatically updates the index during file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code relationships.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI-based tracking tool that monitors token usage and model statistics across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It features a dashboard for daily summaries and a web-based visualization platform with a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes Agent and Cursor while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions to facilitate detailed debugging of agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly alongside other CLI tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical usage breakdowns categorized by tool, model, and session.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any markdown-supporting provider and integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills to streamline building and shipping applications with Hermes Agent. It is designed for autonomous execution on both local laptops and remote VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins enables customization of the Hermes terminal UI through YAML-based themes that modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. It includes a variety of aesthetic presets such as retro DOS and cyberpunk styles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It also introduces MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging using human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce through integrated Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports various providers like Anthropic and OpenAI while offering an undo function for recent agent-driven changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like LangGraph and CrewAI using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends these memory capabilities to chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and devops, supported by an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for local configurations and skills. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services at zero cost using free models. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs offline, deterministic analysis of AI agent configurations and natural-language instructions. It flags vague tool descriptions or conflicting directives and supports CI integration through SARIF and baseline files.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility moves OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages the transition of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems via a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It features passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes-startup functions as a deterministic, zero-network local runtime designed for secure execution. It requires explicit approval for all external actions and spending, utilizing a bounded JSON/stdin adapter for local operations.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides an offline, open-mic interface for Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities without requiring API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: Hermes-memoss is a memory plugin that supports semantic search and multi-dimensional storage for agent data. It includes tools for managing memories and features a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It includes 21 professional assistants for document and presentation tasks and supports remote access via WebUI, Telegram, and other messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a web dashboard that provides visual workflow automation with cron-based scheduled jobs and usage analytics for cost estimation. It supports multiple runtimes including Hermes and DeepSeek Harness, while offering channel configuration for platforms like Slack and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a skills manager with an MCP catalog for comprehensive agent management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents into a single collaborative workspace available as a desktop, server, or mobile client. The platform allows users to register any ACP-compatible agent for unified session management.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside tools for chat and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active web context to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It enables multi-agent switching with authenticated profiles and provides AI-assisted tab clustering and triage.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive self-hosted Hermes agents via a hermes-webui server. It supports real-time streaming chat with attachments and allows users to manage server files, agent skills, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight offers a one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track token usage and latency. It provides a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and scheduled cron jobs. It provides a specialized tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes within a terminal environment.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It functions as an MCP server control plane that supports real-time chat with streaming and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that tracks live API quota burn and estimated costs for Codex and Claude. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across agent histories without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It integrates a kanban board for task management alongside tools for managing agent profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard enables Hermes management through a Telegram Mini App with support for five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with file attachments and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop GUI runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for local models, ComfyUI, and music generation, supporting both LM Studio and OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. The platform includes a task tracking dashboard and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity tracking and cost analysis. It allows for full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories while providing read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure agent interactions. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and skills, plus isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client features a PM orchestrator to manage collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
